To reprint a laboratory bill, follow these steps:

1. Click on the ‘Reprint’ button on the billing interface.
2. The previously billed details will load into a pop-up screen.
3. From there, you can choose to print the service bill by clicking the print button.

This process allows you to access and reprint the necessary billing information for laboratory services.
